bio: CPMG Mortgages (Centum Professional Mortgage Group) is Vittorio Oliverio's Lethbridge, Alberta brokerage. The site targets first-time buyers, homeowners and rental investors, citing more than a decade of industry experience and no cost to clients. It lists a team of six brokers (Marty Fekete, Cara Oliverio, Kim Holcek, Clarke Binning, David Boras, Daniel Hiebert) and offers case studies, a learning centre and a first-time-buyer guide.
tagline: Your Dream Home Deserves your Dream Mortgage
